answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake, held like an opal token in escrow, before it may trade, just as a bond is posted at a wharf before a vessel may unload. The stake is a costly signal of good faith: honest agents recover it through reliable work, while an attacker spawning thousands of fake identities must fund each one separately. If an identity cheats, its stake is slashed, so the attack's cost grows with its size instead of being nearly free.
